jobs.title: Program Manager, Global Go To Market Programs
jobs.description:
Position:
Program Manager, Global Go To Market Programs

Job Description:
Arrow’s Enterprise Computing Solutions (ECS) business is a global technology enablement company that brings innovative IT solutions to the market to solve complex business challenges. We deliver value-added distribution, business consulting, and channel enablement services to the world’s leading technology manufacturers and their channel partners that serve commercial and government markets. Please read more about us https://www.arrow.com/ecs/es

About the Role
Arrow ECS is seeking a highly organized, self-motivated Program Manager to join the Global GTM Programs team. This entry-level role is ideal for an early-career professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys bringing structure to complex initiatives, and can coordinate multiple stakeholders across regions. The Program Manager will support global go-to-market programs by maintaining SharePoint sites, managing documentation, tracking milestones, supporting internal communications, and helping project manage the launch of internal sales enablement tooling, including Highspot-related enablement workstreams.

Key Responsibilities

Program & Project Management
- Coordinate activities across multiple Global GTM Programs initiatives and workstreams.
- Maintain project plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, and action trackers.
- Follow up with stakeholders to drive accountability and ensure deadlines are met.
- Support recurring program cadences, meeting preparation, status reporting, and executive updates.
- Help organize project launch plans, readiness reviews, and post-launch follow-up activities.

SharePoint & Documentation Management
- Maintain and update Global GTM Programs SharePoint sites and related internal landing pages.
- Ensure program documentation, presentations, meeting notes, trackers, and enablement assets are current, easy to find, and well organized.
- Support document governance, version control, naming conventions, and content hygiene.
- Create and maintain project repositories, dashboards, and milestone tracking views.

Sales Enablement Tooling & Launch Support
- Support the internal rollout of sales enablement tooling and related launch activities.
- Coordinate content migration, stakeholder readiness, user communications, testing support, and adoption tracking.
- Partner with GTM, Sales, Marketing, IT, Operations, and regional stakeholders to ensure launch milestones are met.
- Help maintain enablement content repositories so sellers can quickly access approved GTM assets and guidance.

Internal Communications & Change Management
- Support internal communication landing pages, program announcements, launch updates, and stakeholder communications.
- Prepare meeting materials, status updates, leadership summaries, and follow-up notes.
- Capture decisions, action items, blockers, and next steps from cross-functional meetings.
- Help ensure teams understand what is changing, what actions are required, and when deliverables are due.

Stakeholder Coordination
- Operate effectively across North America and EMEA time zones.
- Coordinate with multiple stakeholders while keeping workstreams moving quickly.
- Escalate risks, delays, and missing inputs in a timely and professional manner.
- Build trusted working relationships while holding teams accountable to agreed deliverables.

Preferred Qualifications
- Hands-on experience managing SharePoint sites, document libraries, lists, pages, and content repositories.
- Familiarity with Highspot or similar sales enablement platforms is a plus.
- Experience supporting tool launches, internal communications, or change management activities.
- Exposure to sales, channel, partner, or go-to-market organizations.
- Experience working with globally distributed teams across North America and EMEA.

Key Competencies
- Self-starter with a bias for action
- Highly organized and detail-oriented
- Able to move quickly while maintaining quality
- Comfortable managing ambiguity and changing priorities
- Strong follow-through and accountability mindset
- Collaborative and relationship-focused
- Confident coordinating stakeholders across regions
- Clear communicator with strong documentation discipline

Do you see yourself as our future colleague? If yes – send us your application!
Arrow is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse working environment by providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons.

jobs.description:
Position:
General Manager
Job Description:

Why You'll Love This Role:
Innovation happens when the right people, ideas, and technology come together. At Arrow, our Sales teams connect customers with the expertise, solutions, and global capabilities they need to move faster, solve complex challenges, and stay ahead of what's next.
Working across functions and technologies, you'll build lasting partnerships, deliver value beyond products, and help customers transform ideas into real-world solutions while growing your own career in a global technology organization.

The General Manager position is responsible for all planning, directing, and executing of sales strategy for one of Arrow’s largest markets.   This leader is responsible for meeting/exceeding sales and business operations goals and will perform these functions within the context of Arrow’s objectives, policies and procedures.  The General Manager must be based in Pennsylvania or Southern New Jersey to effectively lead and support the market.

What You'll Do:
- Align the strategic direction of your market to company goals and customer needs in order to build a rigorous business culture.

- Work in partnership with Business Segment Leaders to formulate initiatives and programs that drive the local market success.

- Leverage multiple disciplines of supply chain, manufacturing processes, programming, engineering concepts, tools and resources for the success of the market.

- Lead, motivate, and develop a diversified sales and support team that supports Arrow’s value proposition to customers and suppliers and vertical market strategies in the market.

- Make operational decisions including sales effectiveness, working capital that supports company goals on financial targets by leveraging appropriate support functions.

- Build succession plan for future state, deliver a high performing team.

Who We're Looking For:
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent and 10 years’ experience in electronic component sales/marketing or business development

- Thorough understanding of Distribution

- 5 or more years’ experience leading both regional Field Sales and Inside Sales teams. Experience working with engineering teams a plus.

- Experience managing P&L

- Strong understanding of both sales and business operations

- Knowledge of the PA market.

- Ability to size and scope priorities in the market, understand competitive advantages and disadvantages and deploy resources to grow market share accordingly

- Analytical (scenario analysis), problem-solving, decision-making skills

- Financial, marketing, and profitability analysis

- Organizational and time management skills

- Excellent verbal and written communication and negotiations skills

- Ability to travel regionally up to 30-40%

Work Arrangement:
Remote: The General Manager must be based in Pennsylvania or Southern New Jersey to effectively lead and support the market.

Must be able to travel to an Arrow office location as requested by Arrow leadership. Ability to travel regionally up to 30-40 %.

What’s In It For You:
At Arrow, we are driving innovation and choice by offering employees a variety of benefits designed to keep you and your family physically and financially healthy. Not only do we offer a competitive salary and work-life balance, we offer benefits to match your needs:
- Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance

- 401k, With Matching Contributions

- Paid Time Off

- Health Savings Account (HSA)/Health Reimbursement Account (HRA) Options

- Growth Opportunities

- Short-Term/Long-Term Disability Insurance

We believe new technologies have the power to make life not only different, but better.
At Arrow, we're helping make that future possible. We enable customers and suppliers to design and distribute technology around the world, connecting people, ideas, and innovation to solve real-world challenges.

Guided by our purpose of making the benefits of technology accessible to all, we provide expertise, solutions, and connections that help shape what's next. As a global technology solutions provider, Arrow offers opportunities to learn, collaborate, and build a meaningful career while making an impact around the world.

Life at Arrow
At Arrow, we believe innovation starts with people. We create an environment where collaboration, curiosity, and continuous learning help our employees grow and make a meaningful impact every day.
From your first day, you'll have opportunities to build new skills, work alongside talented teams around the world, and contribute to technology that helps shape a better future. Because when our people grow, innovation moves forward

Position:
Director of Digital Program Management
Job Description:
Why You'll Love This Role:

We believe that data-enabled digital capabilities and customer experiences, data-driven decisions, and predictive commercial insights, are all essential to achieving customer value and business growth at scale. The Digital organization drives this at Arrow by creating scalable, innovative, value-creating digital strategies, capabilities, and operations for the Global Components business.

The Director of Digital Program Management will play a pivotal role as a member of the Digital Leadership Team -- equal parts change agent, master orchestrator and pragmatic optimist, with a strong communication and collaboration skillset. To be effective, this leader must have proven success managing complex digital transformation programs within a global organizational structure that demands a highly collaborative approach, be able to navigate and operate globally, influence and spark change/progress, work well in matrixed organizations, and be ready to define and drive a thoughtful approach to operational program and change management in support of digital transformation at Arrow Global Components.

What You'll Do:
- Lead a global team of program, project and portfolio managers and change leaders.
- Define, communicate, and lead our cross-functional operating model, ways of working and an approach to collaboration that will enable us to make continuous progress towards our strategic digital vision, north star and OKRs/business outcomes.
- Lead and manage all organizational business reviews, program communications, and governance forums (e.g. Steering Committee, Core Team) ensuring understanding and alignment across key global business and functional leadership.
- Collaborate closely with leadership team on decisions regarding program scope, roadmaps and sequencing, trade-offs, and key results (OKRs).
- Establish strong relationships with stakeholders, communicating effectively and proactively to manage expectations and address concerns.
- Partner with Digital Product Management and Business leaders to analyze and develop strategies to address business readiness, operational impacts, process opportunities, and overall change management requirements that may be necessary to achieve business and customer value.
- Partner with Finance and IT to track program budget and to identify and advocate investment strategies across people, process, technology, and data that support progress towards our aligned objectives and outcomes.

- Continuously track, measure, and analyze operational program progress and performance.

- Support development of a Digital organization culture that is customer-centric, learning-based, focused on continuous improvement, and grounded in measurement and data-based decision making.

jobs.description:
Position:
IP&E Finance Director - APAC

Job Description:
IP&E Finance Director - APAC

Principal Accountabilities
- Partner with IP&E leadership and senior leaders, in both other Arrow sales organisations and Functions, across the Greater China and South Asia, Korea, and Japan  regions.

- Provide support to the Global IP&E organization enabling the delivery of global goals.

- Drive the delivery of all financial and business planning and forecasting needs for the Greater China and South Asia, Korea, and Japan  regions and globally for the IP&E sales organization.

- Lead the annual planning and budgeting processes to provide valuable insights and support executive decision making.

- Participate and assume a leadership role in finance initiatives and projects.

- Design, pilot, implement new operational and financial models for key supplier and customer initiatives.

- Direct and participate in cost analysis and margin studies.

- Develop ways to continually improve processes and drive efficiency within the organization.

- Ensure the preparation and presentation of comprehensive financial reporting including but not limited to monthly/quarterly and annual financial statements, trends and KPI’s.

- Have a strong understanding of the business environment and be able to translate issues and opportunities into financial outcomes.

- Define and manage consolidations as well as all finance related processes. Lead due diligence in efforts related to mergers/acquisitions, as needed.

- Coordinate information exchange and monitor conversion testing. Review specific merger related accounting tasks to ensure purchase transactions/entities are properly accounted for.

- Work with and influence cross functional teams globally.

- Oversee the research of complex GAAP issues escalated from Managers and staff; provide direction on technical accounting matters.

- Ensure compliance with country legislation as well as corporate and regional policies and procedures. Ensure the accuracy of the balance sheet and P&L for all Greater China and South Asia, Korea, and Japan  businesses and meet all accounting and reporting deadlines.

- Directs internal audits and SOX audits involving review of accounting and administrative controls.

- Build and lead a high performing finance team, fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.

Job Complexity
- Provides leadership and direction through Senior Managers and Managers and/or may manage large, potentially diverse teams of managers and/or senior professionals.

- Responsible for the performance and results of multiple related units, a medium-sized discipline or department within a region, related disciplines or a medium-sized function in medium-sized division.

- Develop departmental plans, including business, production and/or organizational priorities.

- Controls resources and policy formation in area of responsibility.

- Decisions are guided by resource availability and functional objectives.

- Looks beyond existing methodologies and own discipline to define and resolve complex problems.

- Develop plans and deliver results in fast-changing businesses and/or regulatory environments.

- Provides input to functional or departmental strategy.

Experience / Education
- Typically requires a minimum of 15 years of related experience with a 4-year degree; or 12 years and an advanced degree; or equivalent experience.

- Must be proficient in English and be able to communicate effectively (both written and spoken).

- Strong knowledge of revenue recognition principles and GAAP.

- Experience in a global or large multi-national company preferred.

- Extensive team leadership experience.

- Strong financial modeling and analysis skills with a track record of driving success and achieving financial goals.

jobs.description:
Position:
Marketing Operations Manager
Job Description:
Arrow Electronics is a leading provider of global supply chain solutions, helping businesses optimize and manage complex operations across industries. Our marketing team supports Arrow Global Supply Chain Solutions, SiliconExpert, and Converge—driving engagement, lead generation, and revenue growth through strategic marketing initiatives.

We are seeking a highly skilled Marketing Operations Manager to own the governance, execution, and optimization of our marketing operations ecosystem. This role will be responsible for managing and advancing our marketing technology stack, with a primary focus on HubSpot execution, process governance, and Salesforce integration , while providing secondary support and guidance on WordPress .

This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives in building scalable processes, ensuring data integrity, and operationalizing marketing strategies.

What You'll Be Doing:
- Own and evolve marketing operations governance, including campaign structure, lifecycle stages, data standards, and process compliance across all brands.

- Establish scalable frameworks for campaign execution, lead management, and reporting consistency.

- Act as the central authority for marketing operations best practices, ensuring alignment across marketing, sales, and product teams.

- Serve as the primary platform owner for HubSpot, including hands-on configuration and execution of workflows, automation, and backend processes.

- Build, manage, and optimize lead nurturing workflows, scoring models, segmentation, and lifecycle automation .

- Ensure seamless integration and data flow between HubSpot and Salesforce, including lead routing, attribution, and pipeline visibility.

- Troubleshoot and continuously improve system performance, automation logic, and data synchronization.

- Knowledge of attribution modeling.

- Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting frameworks across HubSpot and Salesforce.

- Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across all systems.

- Deliver actionable insights on campaign performance, funnel health, and ROI.

Marketing Technology & Integrations
- Administer and optimize the marketing technology stack, with HubSpot as the core execution platform.

- Evaluate and implement tools, integrations, and AI-driven solutions to enhance efficiency and scalability.

- Maintain system architecture and ensure all tools are aligned with business and reporting needs.

WordPress & Web Support
- Provide secondary support and guidance on WordPress, partnering with internal or external web teams.

- Ensure proper integration between WordPress and HubSpot for forms, tracking, and lead capture.

- Contribute to conversations around website optimization, conversion paths, and UX from a marketing operations perspective (not primary developer or owner).

What We Are Looking For:
- Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business, Information Systems, or related field.

- 7+ years of experience in marketing operations, marketing automation, or similar roles.

- Deep, hands-on experience with HubSpot (required), including workflows, automation, and system configuration.

- Experience managing HubSpot–Salesforce integrations and understanding of CRM data structures and lead management processes.

- Solid working knowledge of WordPress , with the ability to support (but not lead) web initiatives.

- Knowledge of marketing compliance regulations (e.g., GDPR, CAN-SPAM).

- Strong understanding of marketing data, attribution, lead scoring, and funnel optimization.

- Demonstrated ability to build and enforce scalable processes and governance frameworks.

- Excellent analytical, project management, and cross-functional communication skills.

Preferred Skills:
- Experience in B2B marketing, especially within technology, manufacturing, or supply chain industries.

- Familiarity with AI-driven marketing tools and automation.

- Experience with advanced reporting tools, BI platforms, or SQL.

Work Arrangement:
Hybrid: 3 days in office / 2 days work from home

ECS EMEA - Business Transformation Analyst

- Gap analysis on finance modules and processes between local systems and processes and the AX core model

- Review and validation of IT delivered functional specification documents, and user acceptance testing, including providing formal sign offs

- Support of tool implementation, including AX add-on modules (ex: invoice scanning, cash application tools)

- Support of system migrations including end to end acceptance testing and post go-live support

- Degree in Finance or IT (with experience in finance), minimum of 3 years in a Finance IT role, with previous experience in an ERP implementation

- Detail oriented

- Stress resilient

Our Story
We are an American Fortune 500 company headquartered in Centennial, Colorado. The company specializes in distribution and value-added services relating to electronic components and computer products.

At Arrow ECS we are at the forefront of new internet security technology, providing businesses with technical expertise. As a company we sell, install and maintain customer’s software and hardware solutions such as firewalls, antivirus, web filtering, virtual infrastructures, network traffic load balancers to name a few. Our customers can range from small businesses through to some of the biggest companies in the world. We work with these customers to ensure that their IT infrastructure is, fast, reliable, secure and most importantly working well for their needs.

Our Role
You will join our Business Transformation Business Analyst team which is focused on implementation and customization of the new core applications ecosystem which contains CPQ, Salesforce & ERP systems as main brand applications within the Arrow ECS EMEA region.

On a daily basis you will interact with internal and external stakeholders from different countries to develop and enhance our CPQ tool implementation.
Your role will be to cooperate with business clients, evaluate their needs and requests from a technical and functional point of view. Among your tasks, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality and support of our business community as subject matter expert.

What you will be doing at ARROW:
- Gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements through stakeholder workshops and process analysis.

- Analyze As-Is / To-Be processes, identify gaps, and recommend improvements, standardization and automation opportunities.

- Translate business requirements into clear BRDs and collaborate with IT on solution design.

- Review and validate FDDs to ensure alignment with approved business requirements.

- Define, manage and coordinate UAT and E2E testing, including test scenarios, defect management, and business sign-off.

- Support deployment, go-live, training, and post-go-live activities.

- Manage BA deliverables, risks, dependencies, and priorities across multiple initiatives.

- Build strong relationships with EMEA business and IT stakeholders across countries and functions.

- Proactively identify issues, challenge requirements and solutions when appropriate, and drive actions to resolution.

- Contribute to continuous improvement of capabilities, business processes, and BA ways of working.

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for experienced professional with solid background in business analysis and CPQ projects. We are also looking for people who are naturally empathetic, eager to share their ideas and determined to solve problems, so analytical skills and attention to detail are also desired.

Required Experience & Skills
- 3-4 years of experience in Business Analysis, Business Transformation, IT delivery, or a related role

- Experience with CPQ, CRM, ERP, Salesforce, or similar enterprise applications

- Strong experience in requirements gathering, process analysis, and functional documentation

- Experience with UAT, E2E testing, defect management, and business readiness

- Ability to work effectively with both business and technical teams

- Strong stakeholder management, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a fast-paced environment

- Fluent written and spoken English

Preferred Experience

- Experience in a multi-country / EMEA environment

- Knowledge of BPMN, Visio, ARIS or similar process modelling tools

- Knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics suite and Navision

- Experience with tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar delivery platforms

- Experience with Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies

- Business Analysis or Project Management certification is a plus

Key Competencies
- Strong business acumen and analytical thinking

- Excellent stakeholder management and communication

- Strong ownership and delivery focus

- Ability to challenge constructively and influence decisions

- Collaborative, proactive, and adaptable mindset

- Focus on business outcomes and continuous improvement

What is in it for you?

- Social advantages: CNSS, CIMR, Health insurance,

- Work culture where you can make an impact,

- Dynamic environment with a friendly work atmosphere,

Position:
Finance Manager
Job Description:
Arrow’s Global Supply Chain Services Business Unit is searching for a candidate that thrives in a fast paced, high-pressure, ever-changing environment.  The Finance Manager will perform various functions, including carrying out financial planning and variance analysis, ROWC calculations, margin analysis, monthly forecasting, month-end close, detailed program specific operational and financial processes development and coordination between various departments for effective roll out and implementation of new programs.  In addition, this role will serve as the key Finance Business Partner and have a customer facing role in the organization.

What You'll Be Doing:
- Ability to partner strategically with executive management and business partners.

- Present to management regarding special projects and leadership activities, which rely on analytical conclusions.

- Responsible for establishing and maintaining effective relationships across the business to understand the business and the primary drivers, goals, and the needs of partners and internal customers

- Develop and perform reporting of operating metrics that ensures financial performance, e.g. profitability of different programs or parts.

- Requires a minimum of Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or Business Administration

As a member of Arrow’s Middle and Back Office Treasury team, you will contribute to the global payments process, global bank account administration, Financing/Leasing programs, T&E Management and FX settlement functions. Position:
Sales Operations Manager
Job Description:
Arrow is looking for an experienced Sales Operations Manager to bring their talents to our team!

What You'll Be Doing:
- Lead customer supply chain program orchestration across cross-functional teams, including customer issue resolution, operational strategy development, return material authorization (RMA) oversight, and service delivery for inbound and outbound inventory hub shipments.

- Serve as the primary escalation point for client and operational issues, partnering with internal Arrow teams to resolve supplier, ship-to-site, contract, service, KPI, SLA, and new program capability concerns.

- Design and implement customer-specific processes and special service models that support program goals, operational scalability, and appropriate financial performance.

- Select, develop, and evaluate team members while monitoring work quality, operational execution, and adherence to program KPIs and SLAs.

- Support customer RFQ activities by aligning customer-specific strategies with service and capability requirements that enable program growth and scale.

- Maintain regular client engagement to review program performance, address needs and concerns, and strengthen relationships that support program growth and potential new business opportunities.

- Review finance and operations data, including NSB, fees collected, forecasts, shipment history, inventory, and RMAs, and partner with the appropriate Sales Director to highlight risks, trends, and follow-up needs.

- Prepare and present operational data for QBRs and other client or leadership reviews as needed.
